name: KP World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Announced by K-PRO's own president ahead of the promotion's first show as the prize of an 8-man tournament; billed as held by Shinsuke Nakamura by the time of the promotion's Desperado tour.

name: KP World Jr. Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Announced alongside K-PRO's other titles ahead of the promotion's first show; KENTA defended it successfully against Shuji Kondo on 6 July 2009 for his second defense.

name: KP World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Announced alongside K-PRO's other titles ahead of the promotion's first show; billed as held by Masato Tanaka and Tatsuhito Takaiwa ahead of a defense on 19 July 2009.

name: KP World Trios Championship
epitaph: Held by the visiting No Remorse Corps, who defended it successfully against Team FTW's Tomohiro Ishii, Jado and Gedo on 6 July 2009 for their second defense.
